toolbar.signals.tooltip: Signals (A): Click a crossing to see its approaches, lanes and movements in the colours of their signal groups. On a junction made in this project, add, rename and remove signal groups and give each movement its group.
signals.title: Traffic signals
signals.click_junction: Click a crossing in the map.
signals.status.start: Click a crossing to see its signal groups and movements.
signals.status.target: Crossing #{id}: {approaches} approaches, {movements} movements, {groups, plural, =0 {no signal groups} one {# signal group} other {# signal groups}}. Click a movement or choose its group in the panel.
signals.junction: Crossing #{id}: {approaches} approaches, {movements} movements, {groups, plural, =0 {no signal groups} one {# signal group} other {# signal groups}}
signals.owner.made: Made in this project: the signal groups and movements can be changed.
signals.owner.mismatch: Made in this project, but its file does not match the junction it was made as any more; make it again (for example with the markings tool) before changing its signals.
signals.owner.readonly: Made in this project; signals can only be changed on the base map of a project.
signals.owner.omsi: This crossing comes with OMSI: its signals are shown as they are. Signals can be changed on junctions made in this project.
signals.group.add.tooltip: Adds a signal group that is red for the whole cycle; give movements this group in the list below.
signals.approach: Approach {n} ({lanes, plural, one {# lane} other {# lanes}})
signals.group.name.tooltip: Light number {n} in the crossing's program; the heads of this group name it in their first label.
signals.group.count: {count, plural, =0 {no movements} one {# movement} other {# movements}}
signals.shared_lane: Shared lane: these movements stop at the same line and switch together.
signals.several_lights: This movement passes more than one stop line with different signal groups.
signals.plan.readonly: Shown as OMSI's file has it; nothing here can be changed.
signals.plan.point: Click a movement in the map or in the list.
signals.status.none_here: There is no crossing with at least two approaches here.
signals.done.renamed: Signal group renamed to {name} on junction #{id}
signals.status.heads_show: {count, plural, one {# signal head shows} other {# signal heads show}} group {name}; move them to another group first.
signals.done.unassigned: {text} now has no signal on junction #{id}
signals.status.lost: {count, plural, one {# movement is} other {# movements are}} gone from the junction made anew and lost {count, plural, one {its} other {their}} signal group.
signals.cycle.tooltip: How long one cycle of the program lasts, in seconds; every group starts again after it.
signals.state.tooltip: What the group shows during the selected stretch
signals.segment.start.tooltip: Second at which the stretch starts
signals.segment.length.tooltip: How many seconds the stretch lasts
signals.segment.remove.tooltip: Removes the selected stretch; the one before it takes its time.
signals.segment.repeat.tooltip: Repeats the selected stretch straight after itself; what follows moves on.
signals.timeline.hint: Drag along a row to paint that stretch of time in the chosen colour; drag the edge between two stretches to move it (Shift: tenths of a second).
signals.segment.split.tooltip: Cuts the selected stretch where you clicked it (or in its middle) and paints the part after the cut in the chosen colour.
signals.status.brush_pedestrian: {group} is a pedestrian light: it shows only red and green.
signals.status.split_same: The stretch is already {colour}: choose another colour to paint with; the part after the cut takes it.
signals.status.split_short: This stretch is too short to split.
signals.discard.tooltip: Forgets the changes of the timeline since the last Apply.
signals.apply.tooltip: Writes the changed timeline into the junction, as one step that Ctrl+Z takes back.
signals.timeline.empty: No signal groups yet; add one on the Movements tab.
signals.timeline.pick: Click a stretch to change its colour, start or length.
signals.segment: {group}: {start} to {end} s{holds, select, yes { (holds to the end of the cycle)} other {}}
signals.check.beyond: {group} has phases after {seconds} s that the cycle never reaches.
signals.check.empty: {group} has an empty phase at {seconds} s.
signals.check.green_red: {group} goes from green straight to red at {seconds} s, without yellow.
signals.check.red_green: {group} goes from red straight to green at {seconds} s, without red and yellow.
signals.check.pedestrian: {group} is for pedestrians, whose heads show only red and green, but shows another value at {seconds} s.
signals.check.hold: A stop or jump point at {seconds} s lies outside the cycle or names no group.
signals.status.discarded: The changes of the timeline were not applied and are gone.
signals.status.bad_seconds: Type a number of seconds, 0 or more.
